Whether you're streamlining document control, automating quality event management, integrating training records, or syncing supplier data across systems, the Qualio API provides secure and scalable solutions. Getting started is easy: generate an API key, authenticate your requests, explore example code, and start building. Follow the steps below to integrate with Qualio quickly and efficiently.

  This portal includes everything you need to build with confidence:
- Secure, token-based authentication
- Full reference documentation for each endpoint
- Example code in multiple programming languages
- "Try it out" functionality to test requests live
- Fair usage rate limits to ensure system stability
 

 #### Generate Your API Key 
 To access the API, you’ll need an API key:

- Log in to the [Qualio admin panel](https://app.qualio.com/user-management/admin).

- Navigate to Admin Settings > [Developer API tokens](https://app.qualio.com/user-management/admin/dev-api).

- Click Create token and save the key securely.

- Only users with administrative privileges can generate API keys. 



If you don’t have admin access, please ask your Qualio administrator to create a key for you.
 

 #### Authenticate Your Requests

Qualio uses API key authentication using the X-Api-Key header. Add your API key in the authentication panel to the right to see examples of how to use it in a language of your choice.
 

 #### Make Your First API Call

Here is an easy place to get started: [fetching all your effective documents](#tag/documents/GET/v1/documents/query)
 

 #### Respect Rate Limits

To ensure fair use and maintain performance, API requests are subject to rate limits:

- Each API key has a request threshold of maximum 200 requests per minute
- If you exceed this limit, you'll receive an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) response.
- We recommend implementing retry logic in your client applications, if this is a concern for you.

 

 #### Explore and Build
Use the navigation panel to browse available API endpoints, such as:
- Documents — Create, query, and manage your controlled documents
- User Management — Invite users, update roles, or sync user data
- Audit Trail — Retrieve historical changes for compliance reporting
- You’ll find example code in Python, JavaScript, C#, Ruby, PHP, Go, and Shell for each endpoint. Click “Try it out” to test requests directly from the browser.
 

 #### How is this API versioned? 
 We prefix each URL with the major version of the API. Within this major version, we promise to not make any breaking changes, which are:
 - Changes to the datatype of request or response payload attribute. 
 - Removal of an attribute or parameter. 
 - Changes to a URL. 

 We do not consider the following to be breaking changes: 
 - Additional attributes on return payloads  
 - Additional optional attributes on request payloads 

 
#### Where can I get an OpenApi spec for this? 
 You can [find it here](/download-openapi), but bear in mind that this API is updated regularly, so be sure to fetch it afresh for the latest features
